assumption_policy.authorization_text: 사용자는 추가 PIT 영향측정 없이 PIT 가정을 명시하여 레짐 판독을 연구·승격 판단의 보조 진단에 사용하고, 별도 가정 허용 경로를 구현해 새 캠페인부터 적용하도록 승인했다. 최종 구현 요청: 그렇게 해줘.
assumption_policy.scope: Monthly market and macro regime diagnostics from existing local Bronze snapshots. Existing factor-score inputs, universe construction, promotion gates and registered campaigns are unchanged.
accepted_risks: Stored historical provider values may include revisions not known at the modeled historical decision time.
Historical publication/session times may be provider-reported or explicitly modeled, not independently verified receipt times.
Known source coverage gaps, stale observations and insufficient warm-up remain UNKNOWN and are not imputed.
A regime interpretation may change when an authentic historical vintage or a corrected publication calendar becomes available.
retained_controls: Freeze source bytes, source identity, rules and this policy before each new campaign.
Never substitute a statistics reference date for a release date without an explicit availability assumption.
Use only observations available under the declared convention by each month end; evaluate against the following month.
Preserve existing OOS and embargo boundaries, causal calculations, promotion criteria and label/feature separation.
Do not select regime thresholds, sources, periods or assumptions based on factor performance.
Keep PIT_ASSUMED separate from PIT_VERIFIED in diagnostics, artifacts and downstream interpretation.
